description: Scan the project folder on this computer (or one folder inside it) for leaked API keys and for made-up, brand-new, lookalike or vulnerable packages. Use it for a full pass, for example before you say the work is done; after small edits use yof_check_diff, which reads only the changed lines. Files are read locally and never uploaded; only package names and versions go to npm, PyPI and OSV, unless offline is true. It follows .yof.yml and .gitignore, reads at most 20,000 files (stopped_early says so), looks up at most 500 dependencies and gives up after 90 seconds. Returns counts, must_fix_before_done and up to 100 findings with secrets redacted; an empty list means nothing was found within those limits.

offline.description: true skips the npm, PyPI and OSV lookups, so nothing leaves this computer; package problems are then not reported. Default false.

path.description: A folder inside the project, relative to the project root, for example "src". Default: the whole project. Paths outside the project are refused.

name: yof_check

counts.description: How many findings of each urgency (all of them, not only the listed ones).

dependencies_checked.description: How many dependencies were looked up.

findings.description: At most 100 findings. kind is key or package; value is a prefix plus REDACTED.

file.description: Path relative to the project root.

rule.description: Rule id, for yof_explain, yof_fix_prompt and yof_verify.

more.description: How many findings were left out of the list, when there are more than 100.

must_fix_before_done.description: true when at least one fix_now finding is open.

package_lookups.description: "off", or which registries were asked (names and versions only).

profile.description: The .yof.yml profile that decided which urgencies are shown.

project.description: The folder scanned, relative to the project root.

stopped_early.description: true when the file limit was reached before every file was read.

title: Check the project
